description: This source file contains unit tests for the ProviderService component in the OpenMRS project. It tests various functionalities such as retrieving, saving, retiring, and purging provider entities and related roles and attribute types. The tests verify correct behavior for both normal and edge cases using the JUnit 5 framework.

classes.name: ProviderServiceTest
classes.description: Test class for ProviderService, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest, containing multiple test cases to verify provider-related functionalities.
